faqs.question: Does this plan cover surgery?
faqs.answer: Yes, surgeries are covered up to the insured amount.

faqs.question: Can I add my elderly parents to this plan?
faqs.answer: Yes, our plans allow multi-generational parent additions under the senior rider clause, locking in their care without separate billing.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing conditions covered?
faqs.answer: With the Aegis Supreme Health Shield's optional gold-lock rider, pre-existing diseases are covered starting from Day 1. Under normal conditions, they are unlocked after 1 to 3 years.
